'''Carbonite Prisoner Storage''' was a section of the [[Minimum Security Section]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] that included a [[Melicoste's bunker|bunker]], an open yard, and [[Republic Prison Block South]], where a number of prisoners were kept in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. These included both violent killers and anarchists. During the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] attack on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Lord [[Medechas]] intended to organize the prisoners against the Republic. To accomplish that, he had a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] official defeat the [[Crisis Response Unit]] and free the prisoners in the block.
